dialog.english:
We should keep looking for Tai
and Agumon until we find them.
dialog.translation:
Deberíamos seguir buscando a
Tai y Agumon hasta encontrarlos.

dialog.english:
There's no point. It's been a
month, and we still have no idea
where they are.
dialog.translation:
No tiene sentido. Ha pasado
un mes y seguimos sin saber
dónde están.

dialog.english: Gennai must know something!

Let's go look for Gennai,
everyone!
dialog.translation:
Vamos a buscar a Gennai,
chicos!

dialog.english:
We don't know where he is, either.
How would we even look for him?
dialog.translation:
Tampoco sabemos dónde está.
Cómo lo buscamos?

dialog.english:
I'm tired of this. I wanna go home
right noooooow!
dialog.translation:
Estoy harta. Quiero irme a
casa ya mismooooo!

dialog.english: But T.K...

I don't want him to start
crying...we're leaving to go look
for Tai, after all.
dialog.translation:
No quiero que se ponga a
llorar... total, nos vamos a
buscar a Tai.

dialog.english:
we're leaving to go look for
Tai, after all.
dialog.translation:
nos vamos a buscar a
Tai, después de todo.

dialog.english: Take care, Tokomon.
*yawn*? Mm...

It's impossible. We don't have
enough clues.
dialog.translation:
Es imposible. No tenemos
pistas suficientes.

dialog.english:
I'm sure we'll figure out both
Tai's location and the secrets
of the Emblemas.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que averiguamos dónde
está Tai y los secretos de
los Emblemas.

dialog.english:
I don't know, it doesn't seem very
likely. I don't want to get
everyone's hopes up.
dialog.translation:
No sé, no parece muy
probable. No quiero ilusionar
a todos.

dialog.english:
I understand. In that case, I
don't mind going with only
Tentomon.
dialog.translation:
Entiendo. Entonces no me
importa ir solo con
Tentomon.

dialog.english: Izzy...
Izzy...
Well, we can't stop you.
I'm sure we'll find Gennai!

I'll be goin' with him. Don't pay
us any mind.
dialog.translation:
Me voy con él. No os
preocupéis por nosotros.

dialog.english: Okay, everyone, take care...
All right, see you later.

Joeuuuuuu! Find a ton of food,
okay?

Okay! You shouldn't hang around
doing nothing either, Mimi.
dialog.translation:
Vale! Tampoco te quedes tú
sin hacer nada, Mimi.

dialog.english: Hey, T.K. Let's go, too.
Joe and Gomamon are out late.
I wonder if Joe got lost...

T.K, Mimi, get some sleep. I'll
take my turn at watch.
dialog.translation:
T.K, Mimi, dormid un poco.
Yo hago guardia.

dialog.english:
Don't worry about Joe. I'm sure
he'll find a way back, somehow.
dialog.translation:
No os preocupéis por Joe.
Seguro que vuelve de algún modo.

dialog.english: Mimi, don't be selfish.

I'm sick of this! It's nothing but
walking through the desert!
dialog.translation:
Estoy harta! Esto es solo
caminar por el desierto!

dialog.english: But we were just at an oasis...
I wanna go back to the oasis!

Then what are you gonna do? Live
at the oasis?
dialog.translation:
Y entonces qué? Vas a
vivir en el oasis?

dialog.english:
I'll figure that out later! I'm
going back!
Mimiiii! Don't leave me behind!
Looks like it's just us now.

Let's go, T.K. We'll probably
get out of the desert if we keep
going.
dialog.translation:
Vamos, T.K. Seguro que
salimos del desierto si
seguimos andando.

dialog.english: Heeeeeeeey! Where are you guys?

Heeeeeeeey! I wonder where
everyone went...
dialog.translation:
Eeeeeeh! Dónde estará
todo el mundo...

dialog.english:
Hm? What's this? The Digivice is
reacting to something.
dialog.translation:
Eh? Qué es esto? El
Digivice reacciona a algo.

dialog.english:
It's coming from that direction.
The others must be over there!
dialog.translation:
Viene de esa dirección.
Los demás deben de estar
ahí!

dialog.english:
Let's head to wherever it's coming
from!

The reaction's getting stronger!
We're close!
dialog.translation:
La reacción es más fuerte!
Ya casi estamos!

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaaah!

It's Tokomon! Hang in there,
Tokomon! Are you okay?
dialog.translation:
Es Tokomon! Aguanta,
Tokomon! Estás bien?

dialog.english:
Tai? Agumon? You're
aliiiiiiiive!
Yeah, of course!

Did you get beaten up by an enemy
Digimon, Tokomon?
dialog.translation:
Te dio una paliza algún
Digimon enemigo, Tokomon?

dialog.english:
No, I didn't. I'm just tired and
hungry...
dialog.translation:
No, qué va. Cansado y
hambriento nada más.

dialog.english:
Where's T.K? Where are the
others?
dialog.translation:
Dónde está T.K? Y los
demás?

dialog.english: T.K's with PicoDevimon.
PicoDevimon? Who's that?
PicoDevimon is, uh...

Take it from the top. Tell us what
happened to the others.
dialog.translation:
Cuéntanoslo desde el
principio. Qué les pasó a
los demás.

dialog.english: Okay...

Hey, Matt. I wonder where
everyone went?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Matt, dónde estará
todo el mundo?

dialog.english:
Don't worry. We can get by without
them.
dialog.translation:
No te preocupes. Nos
apañamos sin ellos.

dialog.english:
Doesn't look like we have any more
enemies like Devimon and Etemon.
dialog.translation:
Ya no parece que queden
enemigos como Devimon o
Etemon.

dialog.english:
Matt, we should go back and look
for Tai.
dialog.translation:
Matt, deberíamos volver a
buscar a Tai.

dialog.english: Give up on that!
But...*waaaaaah*

I'm sorry, don't cry! I'm sure
Tai and Agumon are doing okay
somewhere.
dialog.translation:
Lo siento, no llores! Seguro
que Tai y Agumon están
bien en algún sitio.

dialog.english: Tai's alive, right?

Yeah. We'll see him again
sometime.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Ya lo veremos otra
vez.

dialog.english: Huh...?
Could it be...an amusement park?!
I'll go check it out.
Okay, I'll wait here.
Good boy, T.K!
But come back quickly, okay?

Yeah, just wait here. It'll just
be a few hours. I'll be back soon.
dialog.translation:
Sí, espera aquí. Serán solo
unas horas. Vuelvo enseguida.

dialog.english:
Stay strong and protect T.K,
Tokomon!
dialog.translation:
Aguanta y protege a T.K,
Tokomon!

dialog.english: Okay!

Matt...Matt! He was only
supposed to be taking a quick
look...
dialog.translation:
Matt...Matt! Solo iba a
echar un vistazo rápido...

dialog.english:
He said he'd be back soon!
Waaaaaaaaaah!
Don't cry, T.K...
Why are you crying?
My brother hasn't come back.

Huuuuh! That's bad! Okay, I'll go
look for him. What's his name?
dialog.translation:
Anda! Eso es malo! Vale,
voy a buscarlo. Cómo se
llama?

dialog.english: Matt.
All right, just a minute.
Sorry to keep you waiting!
D-did you find Matt?

I found him, but he gave me a
message.
dialog.translation:
Lo encontré, pero me dio
un mensaje.

dialog.english: What...?

Matt said he doesn't want to see
you again.
dialog.translation:
Matt dijo que no quiere
verte más.

dialog.english:
He said he really, really hates
you and doesn't want to be your
brother anymore.
dialog.translation:
Dijo que te odia
muchísimo y que no quiere
ser tu hermano nunca más.

dialog.english: N-No way...
T.K, don't cry...

Oh, and he also said that he hates
you 'cause you're a crybaby.
dialog.translation:
Ah, y también dijo que te
odia porque eres un
llorica.

dialog.english:
*sob* Well, I hate Matt too!
*sob*
dialog.translation:
(llora) Pues yo también
odio a Matt!

dialog.english:
Matt wouldn't say anything like
that! Don't lie to T.K!
dialog.translation:
Matt nunca diría algo así!
No le mientas a T.K!

dialog.english:
Lie? If you've got evidence I'm
lying, show it to me!
dialog.translation:
Mentir? Si tienes pruebas
de que miento, muéstramelas!

dialog.english: I can't do that, but...

Saying that kind of thing's called
slander. You can go to court over
that. Wanna do it?
dialog.translation:
Decir eso se llama
difamación. Podrían llevarte
a juicio. Quieres intentarlo?

dialog.english: Hmmmmmph!
Aaaaaaaaaaagh!
What are you doing, Tokomon?!

Don't blame Tokomon, T.K. He's
just jealous of my relationship
with you.
dialog.translation:
No culpes a Tokomon, T.K.
Solo tiene celos de lo
nuestro.

dialog.english: Tokomon, apologize to PicoDevimon!
No, I won't!
Apologize!

No way! If you want me to
apologize, then I'm out of here!
dialog.translation:
Ni hablar! Si quieres que
me disculpe, me largo!

dialog.english: Really? Okay, then leave!
Do you really want me to leave?
dialog.translation:
De verdad quieres que me
vaya?

dialog.english: Do you really want me to leave?
dialog.translation:
De verdad quieres que me
vaya?

dialog.english:
Yeah, go ahead! Oh yeah, there
aren't any more enemies around, so
I don't need these, either!
dialog.translation:
Sí, vete! Ah, y ya no hay
más enemigos por aquí, así
que tampoco necesito esto!

dialog.english:
And T.K threw away the Tag and
Digivice.
dialog.translation:
Y T.K tiró el Circuito y
el Digivice.

dialog.english: Aaaaaaaaah!
Aaaaaaaaah!
Let's go, PicoDevimon!
Heh heh heh...
And that's why you're alone.
dialog.translation: Y por eso me quedé solo.

dialog.english: Yeah...

I'm worried about Matt, but we 
need to take care of T.K first.
Take us to that amusement park.
dialog.translation:
Me preocupa Matt, pero antes
hay que ocuparse de T.K. Llévanos
a ese parque de atracciones.

dialog.english: Okay.

Heeheehee! Look, T.K, you can
ride anything you want! Isn't it
fun?
dialog.translation:
Jijiji! Mira, T.K, puedes
subir a lo que quieras! A
que es divertido?

dialog.english: Not really.

Hey, T.K, by any chance, are
you still worried about Tokomon?
dialog.translation:
Oye, T.K, por casualidad,
sigues preocupado por
Tokomon?

dialog.english:
I don't care about him! But I
wonder if he's okay by himself...
dialog.translation:
No me importa! Pero me
pregunto si estará bien
él solo...

dialog.english:
(I can't get him to forget about
Tokomon after all. I have to do
something...)
dialog.translation:
(No consigo que se olvide
de Tokomon. Tengo que
hacer algo...)

dialog.english: Nah, he can do whatever he wants.
dialog.translation:
Nah, que haga lo que
quiera.

dialog.english:
Ah, T.K. I just remembered I
have to do an errand! I'll be
right back, heehee!
dialog.translation:
Ah, T.K. Me acabo de
acordar de un recado!
Vuelvo enseguida, jijiji!

dialog.english: Ah! There's T.K!
You're right! Heeeeeeeey, T.K!
Huh?! T-Taiiiiiiiiiii!

Thank goodness. I was worried, I
was so worried..
dialog.translation:
Menos mal. Estaba
preocupado, muy
preocupado..

dialog.english: Sorry about that.
So you came back, Tokomon?
Yeah.

Have you realized what you did
wrong?
dialog.translation:
Te das cuenta de lo que
hiciste mal?

dialog.english: I didn't do anything wrong!

Hey, now. This isn't the time to
fight amongst ourselves. We should
go find Matt.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, ya está. No es momento
de pelearnos entre nosotros.
Hay que buscar a Matt.

dialog.english: I don't want to.
Why?

Everyone left me. First Sora, and
now even Matt.
dialog.translation:
Todos me dejan. Primero Sora,
y ahora hasta Matt.

dialog.english:
Everyone hates me, because I cry
easily, because I'm a kid.
dialog.translation:
Todos me odian, porque
lloro mucho, porque soy
un crío.

dialog.english:
I don't know what PicoDevimon told
you, but Matt doesn't hate you.
dialog.translation:
No sé qué te habrá dicho
DemiDevimon, pero Matt no
te odia.

dialog.english:
He started hating me because I was
only worrying about you!
dialog.translation:
Empezó a odiarme porque
solo me preocupaba por
ti!

dialog.english: Huh?

Hey, Tai, I wanna be *your*
brother instead!
dialog.translation:
Oye, Tai, quiero ser tu
hermano en su lugar!

dialog.english: I can't exactly do that...
Ah, PicoDevimon came back!
Hey, Tokomon, how're you doing?

Look, there's something we want to
ask you.
dialog.translation:
Oye, hay algo que
queremos preguntarte.

dialog.english: W-what do you want to ask?
I'm Tai. This is Agumon.
What did Matt *really* say?

He said he didn't want to see
T.K anymore.
dialog.translation:
Dijo que no quería volver
a ver a T.K.

dialog.english: Really?
I'm not lying.
Can you take us to Matt?
It's a bit far from here.
We don't mind.

Really?...Ah, hey! Why don't we
eat before we go?
dialog.translation:
En serio?...Oye! Por qué no
comemos antes de ir?

dialog.english: I'm hungry!
Let's eat!

Here, I found some delicious
mushrooms. Eat up!
dialog.translation:
Toma, encontré unas setas
deliciosas. Comed!

dialog.english:
(These are the Mushrooms of
Forgetfulness! One bite and you'll
forget everything in your past!)
dialog.translation:
(Son las Setas del Olvido!
Un bocado y olvidaréis
todo vuestro pasado!)

dialog.english: Ah, they look delicious.

Agumon, make some flames so we can
cook them!

Just a minute, I need to use the
bathroom!
dialog.translation:
Un momento, tengo que ir
al baño!

dialog.english: What? Make it quick!

Hm! The same mushrooms are growing
here! Can we *really* eat these?
dialog.translation:
Hm! Aquí también crecen
estas setas! De verdad
podemos comerlas?

dialog.english: Can we *really* eat these?

Don't eat them! If you eat them,
you'll lose all your memories!
dialog.translation:
No las comáis! Si las
comeis, perderéis la
memoria!

dialog.english: W-who's there?

That's weird, but if what I just
heard is true...aaaah, this is
bad!
dialog.translation:
Qué raro, pero si es
cierto lo que acabo de
oír...aaah, qué malo!

dialog.english: Taiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!!

Agumon! We've been waiting for you
so you can start the fire to cook
these with!
dialog.translation:
Agumon! Te esperábamos
para que hicieras fuego
y cocinarlas!

dialog.english: Don't eat those mushrooms!

Don't worry! We've got enough for
you, too.
dialog.translation:
Tranquilo! Hay de sobra
para ti también.

dialog.english: Don't eat them!
What's up with you?
Eat it!
Huuuuuh?!

See, he can't eat them, because
these mushrooms make you lose all
your memories!
dialog.translation:
Mira, no puede comerlas,
porque estas setas hacen
que pierdas la memoria!

dialog.english: No way!

You were lying about Matt too,
weren't you?!
Y-yes...

Horrible...you're horrible. I'm
sorry for how I treated you,
Tokomon.
dialog.translation:
Eres horrible... horrible.
Siento cómo te he
tratado, Tokomon.

dialog.english:
I understand. Don't worry about
it.
Tokomon...

Looks like we've put this
misunderstanding aside.
dialog.translation:
Parece que hemos dejado
atrás el malentendido.

dialog.english:
Looks like we've put this
misunderstanding aside.
dialog.translation:
Parece que hemos dejado
atrás el malentendido.

dialog.english: The Crest...it's glowing!
Y-you! Hand that over!
I'll protect T.K!
Tokomoooooon!
We did it!

Patamon, I'm so sorry for
everything.

Enough with that! It's because of
you that I was able to evolve
again.
dialog.translation:
Basta ya! Gracias a ti he
podido evolucionar de
nuevo.

dialog.english:
I have to apologize to Matt
later, too.
dialog.translation:
A Matt también le pediré
perdón luego.

dialog.english: Yeah.

Anyway, good job figuring out
those mushrooms, Agumon.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, buen trabajo con lo
de las setas, Agumon.

dialog.english: No, it wasn't me. I heard a voice.
dialog.translation:
No, no fui yo. Oí una
voz.

dialog.english: Whose?
I wonder...?

I-I sincerely apologize! The Crest
of Hope has regained its light.
dialog.translation:
Lo siento mucho! El Emblema de
la Esperanza recuperó su brillo.

dialog.english:
The distortions in this world were
affecting the real world.
dialog.translation:
Las distorsiones de aquí
afectaban también al mundo real.

dialog.english:
So before we go back home, we'll
have to get rid of the distortions
here.
dialog.translation:
Antes de volver a casa, hay
que acabar con las
distorsiones de aquí.

dialog.english: Yeah.

We'll have to get everyone to work
together. Including you, T.K.
dialog.translation:
Tendremos que hacer que
todos colaboren. Tú
también, T.K.

dialog.english: I'll do my best!

That's the spirit! Okay, let's go
find the others!
dialog.translation:
Así se habla! Vale,
vamos a buscar a los
demás!

dialog.english: Yeah!
